LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed. Top-left: Causal chain diagram. Top-right: Recorded series (live) line plot. Bottom-left: 32-bit float32 bit-pattern strip. Bottom-right: Monospace state card HUD.

SERIES: The line plot shows four series (w, delta w, gradient, loss). However, the data area is empty; no data points or lines are visible for any series (the plot is blank except for axes and labels). The purple "animated marker" is visible at the top-left of the plot area (near y=1.0), but it has no trail or associated data lines to track.

TEXT: Step number: 19 / 59. w value: -0.055091513100634613. Loss: 1.6531101539611816. FPS readout: 8 FPS drawn | step rate 25/s (top-right panel); 13 FPS drawn (state card). Bit count: bits changed 11 of 32.

BITS: 32 bit squares are drawn. Orange squares (changed this step) are at positions: 5, 6, 9, 12, 14, 20, 21, 22, 23, 28, 31 (counting from left starting at 0). Hex word: 0xBD650BDC.

DEFECTS: The main defect is that the "recorded series (live)" panel is completely empty of plotted data despite being at step 19/59. No lines or points exist for the four defined series, making the primary visualization non-functional in this frame. Additionally, there are two conflicting FPS readouts (8 vs 13).

VERDICT: FAIL. While the layout, text, and bit-level details are correctly rendered, the core "recorded series" panel fails to display any data series or trends, which is a critical rendering failure for a live observatory dashboard.
